clips.title: The story
paras: At Thunderhorn Water Well, tauren and herds draw water in central Mulgore. The well lies along the path between Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff. The valley’s wells sustain life across the grasslands, and the tauren must keep them clean and defended.

Thunderhorn Water Well draws from the aquifers beneath central Mulgore. Nomadic tauren and the valley’s settled villages depend on communal wells for water and sustenance. Water is precious across the plains, and control of the wells means control of the land. The Venture Company has repeatedly sought these sources for industrial use, threatening the balance the tribes work to preserve.
